sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text: Bhadora is an operating cable manufacturer undertaking a large expansion, not a plant-only concept. However, trading mix, weak collections and enlarged capital needs make headline sales an unreliable shortcut to shareholder returns. The completed conditional base gives terminal₹193.27/IRR7.87% versus₹138 entry and requires₹70.46 crore new credit. A 40 crore incremental-credit ceiling fails. Genuine accounting and funding gaps remain, rather than unfinished calculations being labeled uncertainty. [S1] [S5] [S7] [S90]

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Cutoff: 20 October 2026; BHADORA/INE0ZRC01017, NSE SME, listed 11 August 2025. Official 19 October close ₹138, 1,200-share lot and 18.6 million issued shares control the analysis. Standalone Indian GAAP accounts are in crore after converting lakh disclosures. Five annual projections end March2031; return duration from October entry is about4.447 years.15% hurdle and₹5 lakh position are illustrative assumptions. G2 Reliability and G3 Funding are unresolved; G1/G4 Conditional. FY2026 IPO is already in March balances and is never added again. [S1] [S3] [S9] [S90] [S91]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: BQS/GQS/IAS NS because REV and therefore Q are unsupported. All other factor arithmetic and original-weight bounds are retained. Persistent CASH 3 caps GQS at5 separately from its raw missing-data upper bound; G2 also excludes investment rankings. Linked annual models are complete. GOV 4, MOAT 4, DUR 6, CAP 4, CASH 3, BAL 3, EXEC 4 and EARN 4 have issuer-specific supporting and contrary evidence. R 2/D 1/P 3/L 5 are conditional model/implementation assessments. A one-point CAP/CASH change moves BQS known contribution by 0.22 and GQS by 0.25; these are judgment sensitivities, not confidence intervals. No historical9–10 score or invented underlying-sales midpoint is used. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S90]

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Vidhut-branded PVC, aerial-bunched and XLPE cables serve DISCOMs, EPC and industrial buyers. Qualification, metal procurement, manufacturing, testing and collections determine retained value. FY2026 stock-in-trade purchases₹46.4896 crore versus zero in FY2025 indicate a materially changed mix; the annual does not separately disclose corresponding traded sales. Shakun Tech goods consideration is to be settled in plant/machinery, so not every booked receivable is future bank cash. The model separates existing aggregate sales from assumed new-facility output, without claiming that the former is pure manufacturing. [S1]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Technical approvals and product reliability give customer access, but tender economics, metal pass-through and established cable competitors constrain a durable pricing advantage. IPO FY2025 total LT utilization 61.61% conceals XLPE 98.69% versus LT PVC power 1.03%; generic kilometre capacity does not establish demand in the right mix. Dated prospectus peers Dynamic/DCG had EBITDA margins 10.28%/12.57% versus Bhadora 15.42%, but scale, mix and FY2026 trading changes limit comparability. These are contextual operating benchmarks, not current peer valuations or automatic exit multiples. [S3]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: IPO-restated revenue FY2023/24/25 is₹18.4403/81.3932/110.1118 crore; the low FY2023 base yields a two-year CAGR about 144.36%, while FY2024–26 reported CAGR is about 23.89%. FY2026 adds₹14.822 crore,13.46%, to ₹124.9338 crore. These are reported sales calculations, not verified organic manufacturing growth. Material new trading purchases and unknown Shakun transaction size obscure retained-value demand; REV therefore remains NS. July Q1FY2027 update reports₹45.32 crore versus₹13.92 crore, a management sales update without audited cash/profit. [S1] [S3] [S6]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: The June call describes an existing order book exceeding₹100 crore, a major multinational order and expansion into copper/higher-voltage products. These are management claims, not cash realization. Phase 1 budget was enlarged to ₹75–80 crore with October2026 commissioning targeted; actual commencement was not verified through cutoff. Base uses₹75 crore, subtracts opening CWIP₹20.0129 crore and includes both contracted and assumed remaining completion needs. The₹29.41 crore remaining contracts are not added a second time. A further₹75–80 crore phase 2 is excluded from ordinary scenarios because it is not a funded commitment. June monitoring shows only₹0.83 crore unutilized IPO cash, not a large unused rescue pool. [S1] [S4] [S5] [S7]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: The FY2026 auditor reports that audit-trail-capable accounting software was not maintained throughout the year and an edit log could not be examined; management’s upgrade plan is not verified completed remediation. Annual note40 discloses bank-versus-book differences, including Q4 debtors of ₹42.3692 crore submitted to the bank versus ₹52.9315 crore in the books. Management cites timing and valuation adjustments, but a complete reconciliation was not verified. Note16 identifies ₹1.5786 crore of receivables as doubtful without a recognized provision. The June2026 monitoring report says delayed issuer documents limited validation time and certain deployment assertions could not be independently validated. These are specific accounting/control and monitoring exceptions, not findings of diversion, fraud or insolvency. The June monitor reports₹54.79 crore cumulative deployment from₹55.62 crore gross proceeds, plant allocation fully used and working-capital spending₹0.17 crore above allocation; general-purpose completion was three months late. Headline no-deviation language is read with its limitations, not treated as unrestricted clearance. Related-party property advance₹0.26 crore and director borrowing₹1.01 crore need terms/title follow-through; they are not automatically abuse. Historical promises versus delivery are mixed: IPO and factory activity are completed, enlarged-phase commissioning and control remediation remain unverified. [S1] [S4] [S5]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: Annual FY2026 PAT₹9.6596 crore falls 5.02% from₹10.1701 crore, while strict EBIT falls from₹16.0514 crore to ₹15.7900 crore despite sales growth. The call’s₹9.96 crore profit shorthand does not replace signed accounts. Other income₹0.8151 crore and prior-period income₹0.0245 crore are excluded from core EBIT; tax includes₹0.4722 crore earlier-year charge. IPO FY2025 PAT₹10.7869 crore/CFO₹2.3367 crore differ from annual comparatives₹10.1701 crore/₹3.5168 crore and are not concatenated without a bridge. FY2026 CFO−₹26.6023 crore less PPE cash₹18.6499 crore gives−₹45.2522 crore. Debtors absorb₹31.1574 crore, advances₹9.7307 crore and inventory₹4.386 crore; capex alone cannot explain this CFO. Accrual all-funds operating return is about16.86%, latest incremental−0.33%; immature IPO-funded assets explain part, not all, of weak productivity. Closing-share PAT/share₹5.19 differs from weighted EPS ₹5.81. [S1] [S3]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: Reference existing revenue growth 0/3/5/5/5% and new-facility sales 40/100/160/200/220 crore use 11%/14% EBITDA margins, 40% net WC, 2% legacy maintenance, 11% debt cost and 10× exit EBIT. Phase 1 gross remaining capex₹54.9871 crore is spent 70/30%; opening CWIP is not spent again. The model removes₹1.5786 crore doubtful AR from realizable opening WC, funding replacement once. Same-year equal-value Shakun exchanges of ₹10/20 crore remove receivables and replace cash capex together, leaving funding unchanged; they do not invent the actual undisclosed amount. Applying₹10 crore supplier advances to capex similarly removes opening WC once. Cash₹0.3079 crore and pledgedFD₹7.4202 crore stay separate. Current tax₹0.4208 crore/current gratuity₹0.1171 crore settle once, NC gratuity₹0.8612 crore and DTL₹0.3209 crore remain terminal, and future service cost remains in margin. Promoter₹1.01 crore is repaid year 1; maturities are already within gross debt. Base terminal₹193.27/7.87%, bull₹487.57/32.83% require conditional financing. The15% hurdle needs terminal₹256.90, about 43.38% more new-facility sales and₹86.68 crore new debt; this is a demanding funding/operating case, not free rerating. [S1] [S5] [S7] [S90]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Bear reduces existing sales initially 10%, uses 8%/10% margins, 50% WC, 20% project overrun, delayed output, 13% finance cost and 7× exit EBIT. It exhausts shareholder equity despite₹141.59 crore conditional new credit. Denied funding fails liquidity earlier; the model does not assign returns to failed no-credit or₹40 crore-ceiling paths. Base terminal falls to about ₹140.37 at 9%/12% margins,₹167.34 at 50% WC and₹177.28 with 20% phase overrun. Shakun₹20 crore half recovery gives₹185.53; its loss is recognized once, not twice as a debtor and machine loss. Deferred settlement beyond budgeted capex leaves an unresolved separate claim rather than pretending bank cash arrived. Pledged-FD release offers little rescue against the scale of completion and working-capital needs. [S1] [S5] [S90]

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: Fivefold price₹690 requires modeled total sales₹1,401.76 crore, new borrowing₹464.92 crore and cash capex₹306.78 crore. Tenfold₹1,380 requires sales₹2,906.21 crore, borrowing₹1,098.38 crore and capex₹682.89 crore. Unlike a free-capacity extrapolation, output above₹300 crore new-facility revenue is charged additional capex at ₹75 crore per₹300 crore annual sales with 15-year depreciation. This linear capacity rule is an assumption, not verified land, permits, delivery timing or financing. Neither management phase targets nor grid-spending headlines establish these outcomes. [S1] [S5] [S90]

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Reconcile bank/book inventory and debtor submissions and demonstrate audit-trail remediation. Obtain Shakun amount, machinery specifications, delivery/settlement dates and supplier-advance purpose. Track recoveries against₹52.9315 crore AR and₹1.5786 crore unprovided doubtful balances. Confirm actual phase 1 commissioning, cost-to-complete and utilization by product rather than total kilometres. Obtain sanctioned facility terms, available limits, drawdowns and working-capital headroom versus modeled₹70.46 crore need. Reconcile FY2025 profit/cash and the actuarial roll-forward/current classification. Track IPO-monitor limitations and rectification, subsidy recovery, property-advance title and related-loan terms. Refresh ESM, participant concentration and executable lot-sized depth. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S5] [S7] [S90] [S96]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Completed full-model review with unresolved reliability and funding, not a numerical ranking candidate. Real cable demand and optimistic operating scenarios do not establish available credit or underlying manufacturing growth. All 60 recent sessions have observations; the lower 60-day mean/median is₹2.60217 million, giving₹5 lakh theoretical exit 3.843 days at 5%, 9.607 days at 2% and 1.921 days at 10%. The20-day median₹4.33521 million gives 2.307 days at 5%. One lot costs₹165,600; ESM StageI, fewer than 100 PAN and latest 8 trades warrant a conservativeL 5. Exchange irregular-trading caution is disclosed, not converted into fictitious missing days or a suspension finding. [S90] [S91] [S92] [S95] [S96]

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Primary annual, IPO, monitoring and management disclosures were inspected selectively. Model assumptions cannot repair bank-reporting or comparative-account evidence. The financial-note gratuity split totals₹0.9783 crore, but the actuarial table shows₹0.1176 crore current versus₹0.1171 crore in the balance note and inconsistent opening/expense movements. Reference follows financial-note current/NC claims, with₹0.0005 crore extra-claim sensitivity; no imaginary actuarial reconciliation or separate plan asset is inserted. Remaining unknowns include actual Shakun amount, supplier-advance use, traded/manufactured sales, loan availability and verified commissioning. All borrower-credit paths are conditional; no IPO proceeds or pledged cash are counted twice. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S5] [S7]

GOV.reason: Audit-trail, bank-reporting and monitoring-validation weaknesses warrant 4. Contrary: issues are disclosed, an IPO-use audit KAM exists and no evidenced diversion or severe minority abuse is established. A control exception is not automatically G1 failure.

MOAT.reason: Utility qualification, product reliability and existing XLPE utilization support useful capability. Contrary: tender competition, metal pass-through, low utilization in other products and trading mix do not prove durable excess pricing. Ordinary/weak differentiation supports 4.

REV.reason: Reported historical growth can be calculated, but46.4896 crore stock-in-trade purchases replace a zero prior-year base and traded revenue is not separated. This materially obscures underlying manufacturing expansion. Missing the demand/retained-value bridge is actual evidence absence, not merely a low growth score.

DUR.reason: Grid/customer qualifications, high XLPE use and disclosed orders support accessible expansion. Contrary: product-specific demand, commissioning and financing constrain duration. Phase 2 is not counted as secured runway;6 reflects opportunity with substantial execution needs.

CAP.reason: All-funds return about16.86% is respectable, but the latest incremental return is slightly negative while large CWIP and advances await cash profits. Mixed legacy/new cohorts support4, not NS merely because the project is unfinished and not a claim of persistent negative capital returns.

CASH.reason: FY2024 IPO CFO/PAT about56.7%, FY2025 annual about34.6% and FY2026 deeply negative conversion establish repeated weak realization, despite comparative-basis caveats. Rising doubtful balances and noncash settlement are not explained solely by capex. CASH 3 and a persistent-cash GQS cap 5 are supported; older positive cash is contrary evidence against calling every year cash-negative.

BAL.reason: The reference requires70.46 crore additional conditional borrowing; a 40 crore ceiling and no-credit paths fail. Pledged deposits and existing term maturities cannot be ignored. Contrary: there are existing facilities, operating assets and management-reported sanction, so this is funding fragility, not an evidenced existing default.

EXEC.reason: Existing factory use and revenue expansion are positive; new plant remains a target after timing slippage and enlarged budget. Monitoring limitations and lack of verified commissioning constrain execution to 4, without treating a plan as a delivered result.

EARN.reason: Strict EBIT slips despite higher sales; PAT and diluted EPS also fall. Trading mix and prior-year comparatives complicate normalization. Contrary: meaningful operating earnings remain and other income is not the dominant profit source;4 reflects weak profit-growth quality.

R.reason: Conditional base IRR7.87% minus15% hurdle is−7.13percentage points, R 2. Point forecasts remain uncertain and G2/G3 block certification; this numerical band is a model result, not a verified financing promise.

D.reason: Bear exhausts equity despite141.59 crore conditional new credit; less funding fails earlier. Contrary: genuine factory assets and an optimistic operating path have value, but at entry they do not provide reliable severe-stress shareholder recovery.

P.reason: The15% hurdle needs about 43.38% more new-facility sales than base and86.68 crore new credit, with extra capacity explicitly funded. Several favorable collection, commissioning and margin assumptions must hold together, supporting3 rather than a conservative valuation cushion.

L.reason: The60-day lower mean/median gives3.843 days, startingband7. Downgrade to 5 for ESM StageI, fewer than 100 PAN, latest 8 trades and165600rupee lot granularity. Contrary: all60sessions have observations, so the exchange irregular-trading caution is not invented illiquidity or suspension.

Q.reason: BQS incomplete because underlying revenue growth is not established; no renormalization or midpoint substituted.
